findings.evidence: tools/node-parity-runner/cases/worker_threads/worker-port-held.case.ts:36 setTimeout(... terminate ..., 400); no carrier holds a worker longer than 30 s
findings.summary: Fault row unbounded-read: its only carrier, Parity 7, terminates at +400 ms, so it cannot tell an uncapped worker-thread drain (ADR-0446 §5) from a capped one (e.g. ADR-0152 §4's 30 s cap, which ADR-0446 §Rejected says kills listening pool workers). The 'worker drain is uncapped' half has no discriminating carrier. At Final+GREEN, check the bootstrap's worker-thread awaitDrain cap by reading.

findings.evidence: grep: all 7 worker_threads cases' setup files are *.cjs; ESM worker parentPort exists at BASE only in env-semantics.case.ts (worker-env-child.mjs)
findings.summary: Every new carrier uses a CommonJS parent and CommonJS worker scripts (require('node:worker_threads')). vitest 4.1.11 pool workers are ESM (`import { parentPort }`, init-threads.6kl1khcL.js:9-11). ESM-realm parentPort referencing and ESM worker natural exit are first exercised at item 12. Optional hardening: add an .mjs worker to Parity 6/7.

The unit also changes natural exit for node <file>, node -e, and the fork, .bin and execSync owners (ADR-0446 §6, Parity 8/11/12). The title names only the worker-thread clause. It is a justified sibling sweep of the map open question, traced to I3. §6 also refines ADR-0445 rule 6 ('calls exit()') for the non-worker owners, but the README correction row's seam column names only '0445 rule 6 worker-thread clause'. RDY-4/DEC-2 advisory: state it in the title and the seam column.

findings.summary: The honest-outcome text of the unbounded-read row misdescribes BASE. It says '.bin/execSync keep ADR-0152 §4's loud 30 s cap', but .bin and spawn/fork children launch with nodeServe: true and take the uncapped lifecycle drain. Only the execSync recursive runner (nodeServe: false) reaches the capped else-branch. The bootstrap comment at node-entry-bootstrap.ts:169 ('else-branch (.bin/execSync)') is stale too. The promise 'the parent's own drain policy is unchanged' is unaffected. Correct the parenthetical.
